units.name: CO2 Feed Compressor
units.purpose: Compress purchased CO2 from delivery pressure to synthesis-loop pressure.

units.name: H2 Feed Compressor
units.purpose: Compress purchased hydrogen from delivery pressure to synthesis-loop pressure.

units.name: Feed Mixer
units.purpose: Combine fresh CO2 and H2 with compressed recycle gas at the reactor feed ratio.

units.name: Feed-Effluent Exchanger
units.purpose: Recover reactor-effluent sensible heat to preheat the mixed synthesis feed.

units.name: Synthesis Reactor
units.purpose: Convert CO2 and H2 to methanol and water with concurrent reverse water-gas shift over the selected catalyst.

units.name: Reactor Heat Management
units.purpose: Supply or remove net reaction heat to control the multi-bed reactor temperature, recovering useful heat when the net chemistry is exothermic.

units.name: Effluent Cooler
units.purpose: Cool heat-recovered effluent to condense methanol and water before phase separation.

units.name: Condensate Knockout
units.purpose: Separate condensed crude methanol-water liquid from uncondensed H2, CO2 and CO-rich recycle gas.

units.name: Recycle Purge Splitter
units.purpose: Purge a controlled fraction of uncondensed gas to prevent CO and impurity accumulation and send the remainder to recycle.

units.name: Recycle Compressor
units.purpose: Restore recycle gas pressure losses before remixing with fresh feeds.

units.name: Crude Methanol Distillation
units.purpose: Purify crude condensate to specification methanol and reject a water-rich bottoms stream.

units.name: Utilities and Offsites
units.purpose: Provide common cooling, steam, electrical distribution and wastewater handling and account for associated installed facilities.

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: No universal in-situ regeneration protocol is supported across the diverse catalyst families; spent catalyst replacement and lifetime are costed instead.

product_compression.excluded: Specification methanol leaves as a condensed liquid at the stated product pressure, so no product-gas compression is required within these battery limits.

diagram:
CO2 -> [CO2 Feed Compressor] --\
                                  > [Feed Mixer] -> [Feed-Effluent Exchanger] -> [Synthesis Reactor] -> [Reactor Heat Management] --hot side--> [Feed-Effluent Exchanger] -> [Effluent Cooler] -> [Condensate Knockout] --liquid--> [Crude Methanol Distillation] -> CH3OH product
H2  -> [H2 Feed Compressor] --/                                                                                                                                        |                                      \-> [Utilities and Offsites] -> treated water
                                                                                                                                                                      \--gas--> [Recycle Purge Splitter] --purge--> boundary
                                                                                                                                                                                        \-> [Recycle Compressor] -> recycle to Feed Mixer
